usage_instructions: Use `tiktok` when you need TikTok transcript downloads or when you need to inspect or manage the CLI's authentication profiles. Check the target subcommand entry before running mutating auth actions.

transcripts.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok transcripts` for transcript download work. The normal execution path is `transcripts download`, which accepts one or more TikTok URLs and writes subtitle files to disk.

download.help: Download transcripts for one or more TikTok videos.
download.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok transcripts download URL...` to fetch subtitles for one or more TikTok videos. Set `--output-dir` to control the destination folder, `--format` and `--lang` to control subtitle output, and `--table` when you want a compact result summary.

auth.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok auth` to manage stored credentials and profile state. `auth status` is the read-only inspection path, `auth login` writes credentials, and `auth profiles` manages named profiles.

login.help: Configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent.
login.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok auth login` to save or refresh credentials for the current or selected profile. Add `--profile NAME` to target a non-default profile and `--force` only when you intend to clear runtime auth state before logging in again.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to save credentials to

logout.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok auth logout` to remove stored credentials from the current or selected profile. Add `--profile NAME` when you need to clear a non-default profile.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to clear credentials from

status.help: Check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. Saved credentials whose live verification fails are reported as ``authenticated: false`` with the failure reason in ``api_test``.
status.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok auth status` to verify whether stored credentials are actually usable. Add `--profile NAME` to inspect one profile or `--table` for a human-readable summary.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to check (defaults to all profiles)

test.help: Test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles.
test.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok auth test` when you want an explicit credential verification run. Add `--profile NAME` to scope the check, `--table` for summary output, and `--verbose` for detailed per-check diagnostics.

profiles.usage_instructions: Use `tiktok auth profiles` to inspect, create, select, and remove named authentication profiles. The most common read paths are `profiles list` and `profiles get`, while `profiles select` switches the active profile within its auth type.

list.help: List all profiles and show their auth types and active state.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of profiles to return

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated list of fields to include

get.help: Get details for a specific profile.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to get details for

create.help: Create a new profile from .env.example template.

delete.help: Delete a profile and its data.

remove.help: Delete a profile and its data.

select.help: Activate a profile within its auth type.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to activate within its auth type

select.usage_instructions: Use `auth profiles select NAME` to activate NAME within its auth type. Other auth types keep their active profiles unchanged.
